metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Engine Breakdown Recovery & Nationwide Collection | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Professional nationwide engine recovery and collection for Mercedes-Benz. Flatbed transport for all models including 4MATIC, AMG & EQ. Get your car to our workshop safely.
h1: Mercedes-Benz Engine Breakdown Recovery & Nationwide Collection
lede: Safe, professional flatbed recovery for every Mercedes-Benz – from A-Class to Sprinter, 4MATIC to AMG. We bring your vehicle to our workshop, no matter where you are in the UK.

sections.heading: What our nationwide recovery service involves

blocks.html: We collect your Mercedes-Benz from anywhere in the UK and bring it to our specialist workshop in Essex. Every step is carried out by experienced drivers using the correct equipment for your model.

items: **Fast booking:** Call or use our online form – we'll arrange the earliest available slot.
**Professional dispatch:** We assign a flatbed truck equipped for Mercedes-Benz models, including low-clearance and 4MATIC vehicles.
**Safe loading:** Our drivers use extended ramps and winch systems to protect your car's bodywork and underbody.
**Secure transport:** Your vehicle is strapped down with wheel-tie and axle straps to prevent any movement during transit.
**Workshop arrival:** We unload carefully and hand over the vehicle for inspection or the booked repair.

blocks.html: We handle everything from a simple roadside breakdown to a non-runner collected from your home – just tell us the condition and location when you book.

paras: [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer) – final cost depends on distance and vehicle type.

sections.heading: Our recovery process step by step

steps.body: Call us on **0203 488 4649** or use our online form. Provide your registration, location, and vehicle condition.
We send the nearest available flatbed truck. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking during working hours.
Our driver inspects the vehicle, uses extended ramps if needed, and winches it onto the flatbed with full care.
The car is strapped down and transported to our workshop in Billericay, Essex.
We unload the vehicle and perform a handover – if you've booked a repair, we begin the inspection straight away.
We'll contact you with an assessment and quote for any necessary work, or proceed with your pre-booked service.

sections.heading: Why choose us for your Mercedes-Benz recovery

items: **Mercedes-Benz specialists** – we know the towing requirements for 4MATIC, AMG, EQ, and low-clearance models.
**Nationwide coverage** – we collect from anywhere in the UK, from city streets to remote locations.
**Flatbed-only policy** – we never tow a Mercedes on two wheels; every vehicle travels on a flatbed to prevent transmission damage.
**Experienced drivers** – trained in safe loading and strapping techniques specific to each model.
**Transparent pricing** – fixed rates with no hidden fees. [See our pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).
**Established 2009** – trusted by hundreds of Mercedes owners across the UK. [Learn more about us](/about).

steps.body: Reach us by phone or fill in the quick form. We'll ask for your registration, location, and vehicle condition.

items.q: Do you recover all Mercedes-Benz models?
items.a: Yes, we recover every Mercedes-Benz passenger car, SUV, and commercial vehicle – including A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, S-Class, G-Class, Sprinter, Vito, AMG models, and even EQ electric vehicles.

items.q: Is a flatbed always required for 4MATIC and AMG models?
items.a: Absolutely. Mercedes-Benz officially recommends flatbed transport for all 4MATIC and AMG vehicles to avoid damaging the transfer case or drivetrain. We never use two-wheel towing for these models.
We aim to have a truck with you within a few hours of booking during working hours. Nationwide transport to our workshop typically takes one to two days, depending on distance.

items.q: What if my car has low ground clearance or air suspension?
items.a: We use extended ramps and carefully adjust the winch speed to protect the front bumper and underbody. For vehicles with Airmatic, we can activate recovery mode if available.

items.q: Do you charge extra for weekend or out-of-hours recovery?
items.a: Our standard rates apply during Monday–Friday 9am–6pm and Saturday 11am–2pm. For emergency out-of-hours collections, please call us for a personalised quote.
